listing.name: Mario Forever: Community Edition
listing.summary: Use a permitted Mario Forever: Community Edition copy, the community remake of Mario Forever.

steps.title: Use your permitted existing player
steps.instruction: Keep the complete existing Windows or Linux package together. Select its native Mario Forever Community Edition game executable and containing folder. This is a self-contained community remake of Mario Forever; it does not ask for a commercial Super Mario ROM.

steps.title: Keep the existing profile
steps.instruction: Upstream places saves, settings and logs in the user-data folder MeteoDream/Mario Forever Community Edition. Preserve that actual profile, any custom location and your existing working package before changing versions.

steps.title: Play and update deliberately
steps.instruction: Choose Play explicitly after registering the existing player. Runtime updates and external profiles remain with you and upstream; Portcove does not replace, back up or remove those files.

warnings: The project’s original contributions and bundled third-party game assets have separate distribution terms. Existing-copy registration does not certify those assets or grant acquisition permission.

listing.download_block_reason: New downloads are paused while the bundled third-party game assets are reviewed. Keep using your permitted existing copy; downloads can resume when the package’s distribution terms are established.
